description: Search ZipRecruiter jobs by keyword, location or company, scrape exact URLs, or read salary benchmarks. Descriptions, benefits, company profiles and structured pay are optional.

companyName.description: Only jobs from this employer, e.g. `Visa`. Leave the keywords empty to browse every open role at the company.
companyName.title: Company name

daysPosted.description: Only jobs posted within the last N days. 0 means any time.
daysPosted.title: Posted within (days)

experienceLevels.description: Restrict to one or more seniority levels. Empty means no filter.
experienceLevels.title: Experience levels

fetchDescriptions.description: Fetch each posting's detail page for the complete description, benefits, company profile and apply details. Off gives faster card-only rows.
fetchDescriptions.title: Fetch full descriptions

includeCompanyProfile.description: Add industry, website, size, headquarters, rating and about text from the posting's company data.
includeCompanyProfile.title: Include company profile

locations.description: Cities, states, ZIP codes or `United States` for a nationwide search. Every keyword is searched in every location.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Maximum number of job or salary records to return across all searches and URLs.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxSearches.description: Cap on keyword × location combinations in search mode.
maxSearches.title: Max searches

mode.description: Search job postings, scrape URLs you already have, or get salary benchmarks for a role and location.
mode.title: What do you want to scrape?

radiusMiles.description: Distance around each location. 0 uses ZipRecruiter's default.
radiusMiles.title: Search radius (miles)

salaryLocations.description: Cities, states or `United States` for salary benchmarks. Every role is looked up in every location.
salaryLocations.title: Salary locations

salaryMax.description: Only jobs whose advertised annual pay stays at or below this amount. Best effort; 0 means no upper bound.
salaryMax.title: Maximum annual salary (USD)

salaryMin.description: Only jobs whose advertised annual pay reaches this amount. 0 means no lower bound.
salaryMin.title: Minimum annual salary (USD)

salaryRoles.description: Job titles for salary benchmarks, e.g. `registered nurse` or `data analyst`. Used in salary mode.
salaryRoles.title: Salary roles

salaryUrls.description: Exact ZipRecruiter `/Salaries/...` URLs. When set, these are used instead of role and location pairs.
salaryUrls.title: Salary page URLs

searchQueries.description: Job titles or keywords, e.g. `registered nurse` or `software engineer`. Every keyword is searched in every location below.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

startUrls.description: Search, job, company or salary URLs. Use this with `Scrape specific URLs`; filters already in a search URL are kept.
startUrls.title: ZipRecruiter URLs

title: ZipRecruiter Jobs & Salary Scraper Input
